title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Attack and Receive Pharaoh's Servant PSV-054 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a must-have for any collector or player. It features the Attack and Receive action trap, with a card number of PSV-054 and rarity of Common. The card is from the Pharaoh's Servant set, manufactured by Konami. 

This card is perfect for anyone looking to add to their collection or improve their gameplay strategy. Its 1st Edition status and Trap-Normal card type make it a valuable addition to any Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG deck. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and sought-after card.
